t: Don’t Buy Ocarinas from Amazon (Reviewing OcarinaWind and other brands)
s: November 6, 2022 - I was surprised at how good some of these inexpensive ocarinas are (from Awef and Zragek), but I strongly believe it’s best to support reliable vendors and makers like Songbird, Imperial City, STL, Luna Celta, Night, and the like. That said, if you’re looking to try a ceramic Ocarina and don’t have a high budget, I offer two options: Save your money until you can afford an instrument from a reliable vendor—among these vendors, Imperial City is the generally most affordable · If not, buy one of the ocarinas I rated highly today!
